note: Everything the narrator says. {say} is a country's or continent's spoken name (world.json 'say'); {capital} its capital city (levels.json 'capitals'). dev/voices.py renders a clip for each line; the game looks clips up by their exact text.

country.capital: Find the country with the capital city {capital}.
country.capitalYes: Yes! {capital} is the capital city of {say}.

shared.fly-world: Let's look at the whole world!

finale.up: You flew all around the world! Now let's fly up into space.
finale.sun: This is the Sun. It keeps us warm, and it gives us light.
finale.spin: The Earth spins round and round.
finale.day: When our home faces the Sun, it's day.
finale.night: When it turns away, it's night.
finale.tilt: Look! The Earth is a little bit tipped over, like this.
finale.star: And it always points the same way, at the North Star.
finale.year: Every year, the Earth travels all the way around the Sun.
finale.summer1: When our half of the Earth leans toward the Sun, the sunshine is strong, and the days are long.
finale.winter1: Half a year later, our half leans away from the Sun.
finale.winter2: The sunshine is weak, and the days are short.
finale.why: Why is summer warm, and winter cold? Let's look at the sunshine.
finale.high: In summer, the Sun is high up. Its light lands on a small spot, so the ground gets warm.
finale.low: In winter, the Sun stays low. The same light spreads out over a bigger place, so the ground stays cold.
finale.move: Now you move the Sun, up and down!
finale.australia: And guess what? When it's winter here, it's summer in Australia!
finale.between: In between come spring and fall.
finale.try: Now you try! Push the Earth around the Sun.
finale.push: Push the Earth along the circle.
finale.end1: The Earth goes round and round, and the seasons come again and again.
